kjv.2001022: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
kjv.2002002: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
kjv.2002003: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.
kjv.2002004: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
kjv.2002010: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
kjv.2002012: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
kjv.2002014: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
kjv.2002015: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
kjv.2002016: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
kjv.2002017: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
kjv.2002021: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
kjv.2002022: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
kjv.2002023: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
kjv.2002024: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
kjv.2003001: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
kjv.2003002: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
kjv.2003004: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
kjv.2003005: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
kjv.2003007: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
kjv.2003011: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
kjv.2003014: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
kjv.2004001: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
kjv.2004010: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
kjv.2004014: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
kjv.2004018: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
kjv.2004020: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
kjv.2004024: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
kjv.2004027: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
kjv.2004031: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
kjv.2005001: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
kjv.2005002: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
kjv.2006020: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
kjv.2007001: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
kjv.2007007: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
kjv.2007012: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

kjv.5034010: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

kjv.43001017: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

kjv.44007022: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
kjv.44007023: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
kjv.44007030: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
kjv.44007037: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
kjv.2014021-2014022: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided. And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
kjv.58011024-58011027: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter; Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season; Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward. By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

claims.text: His brother, three years older by Exodus 7:7, given to him as spokesman: "he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God".
God made Aaron Moses' spokesman before the people and Pharaoh.

quote.text: See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

claims.text: His sister and Aaron’s, "the prophetess", who led the women’s song at the sea and later spoke against him with Aaron.
Miriam "the prophetess" led the women after the crossing of the sea; Micah names her with Moses and Aaron as sent before the people.
"His servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle"; he asked Moses to forbid Eldad and Medad.
The priest of Midian, his father-in-law, whose flock he kept when he was called at the bush.
Two men who prophesied in the camp; Moses would not forbid them.

Two men who "were of them that were written" stayed in the camp, and the spirit rested on them there; when Joshua said "forbid them", Moses answered "would God that all the LORD's people were prophets".
With Dathan and Abiram he gathered against Moses and Aaron: "Ye take too much upon you".
Exodus does not name Pharaoh’s magicians, who did "in like manner with their enchantments". 2 Timothy names two men who "withstood Moses", Jannes and Jambres, and says no more about them.

Moses and Aaron brought Pharaoh the LORD’s word, "Let my people go", and Pharaoh answered, "Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go?" After the darkness Pharaoh told Moses he would die the day he saw his face again, and Moses answered, "Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more."

claims.text: Edom and Moab refused Israel passage, as Jephthah later recalled; he also asked of Balak king of Moab, "did he ever fight against them".
Both kings were defeated, and their lands given to the tribes east of the Jordan.
Both kings were defeated, and their lands given to the tribes east of the Jordan.
Five kings of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba, were killed in the war of Numbers 31.

Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.
Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.
